verdict.rationale: Yubico documents that FIDO2 on the YubiKey can enforce user verification via PIN entry on top of touch-based user presence. The ykman CLI manages PINs, and community users confirm setting a FIDO2 PIN before enrolling, which satisfies the 'PIN or biometric' requirement. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party FIDO2 PIN/UV reference (evidence is one line in an SSH guide), any evidence of a built-in biometric option, and documentation of enforcing UV by default (the community notes the key ships with no PIN set).

support.subject: As a security engineer, the key supports on-device user verification — a FIDO2 PIN or built-in biometric — so a stolen key alone cannot authenticate

citations.quote: FIDO2 also requires user presence (a touch on your YubiKey) for cryptographic operations, and can optionally enforce user verification (PIN entry).
Full scriptable device management: enable applications, PINs, PIV/OATH/OTP slots, device info.
you need to unenroll everywhere, set a PIN, and enroll again
